round(3.14159)
round(3.14159, digits = 2)

Exercise 2: Argument order
```{r}
rep(5,7)
rep(x = 5, times = 7)
```

Exercise 3: Assigning values to variables
```{r}
number <- 8
name <- "matilda"
logic <- TRUE

print(number)
print(class(number))
print(name)
print(class(name))
print(logic)
print(class(logic))
```
Exercise 4: Using variables of different types
```{r}
cell_ID1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID2 <- "CX2"
treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE
before_1 <- 5415
before_2 <- 8123
after_1 <- 1432
after_2 <- 7543

cell_ID <- c(cell_ID1, cell_ID2)
treated <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
before <- c(before_1, before_2)
after <- c(after_1, after_2)
print(after)
```

```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
pet <- all_my_pets[4]
print((pet))
```

```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
cell <- tibble(
  cell_ID = cell_ID,
  treated = treated,
  before = before,
  after = after
)
gt(cell)
```
